name: GXW Unified World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: The promotion's own top championship, changing hands at least three times across the held record's three-year record and carried into its renamed 'GWE' era by the same wrestler who was still defending it when this pass's own reading ends.

name: GXW Continental Championship
epitaph: A secondary singles championship held across this corpus's own record by two wrestlers, the second still attested as champion when this pass's own reading ends.

name: GXW Television Championship
epitaph: The promotion's own most actively defended championship in the held record, changing hands at least four times in its first year alone before settling into a reign this corpus never sees end.

name: GXW X-treme Championship
epitaph: A championship contested in gimmick and multi-man matches throughout this corpus's own record, held by at least three different wrestlers across the run this pass read.

name: GXW Cruiserweight Championship
epitaph: A championship contested at least three times in this promotion's own show lineups with no marked incumbent surviving among them; the promotion's own year-end staff retrospective separately names its earliest attested champion, Inferno, in 2002.

name: GXW World Tag Team Championship
epitaph: The promotion's own tag team championship, held by three different teams across this corpus's own record and still live in its final attested defense.

name: GXW Women's Championship
epitaph: The promotion's own women's championship, attested by name across this corpus's own record with a single marked champion surviving in the pages read this pass.

name: GXW Television Tag Team Championship
epitaph: A second, short-lived tag championship the promotion ran alongside its main World Tag Team title for at least the two months this wing's own Front Office record attests, never mentioned again after December 2001.
